# parity_x64.bin layout

Raw x86-64 blob (512 bytes, no file header) generated by `make_fixture.py`.
Tests load it with Binary Ninja's Mapped loader (platform `windows-x86_64`)
and Ghidra's `ProgramBuilder`, both at image base **0x400000** unless a rebase
test says otherwise. Offsets below are file offsets; add the image base for
virtual addresses (e.g. `func_ret` = 0x400000).

Functions are always created explicitly by the tests — auto-analysis results
are never asserted on.

| Offset | Name (by convention) | Bytes | Purpose |
|--------|----------------------|-------|---------|
| 0x000 | `func_ret`    | `c3` | smallest function; symbol/comment/signature tests |
| 0x010 | `func_equate` | `b8 f4 01 00 00 c3` (`mov eax, 0x1F4; ret`) | immediate 500 at operand index 1 — equate tests |
| 0x020 | `func_frame`  | rbp-framed body, stack local at `[rbp-8]` | parameter/stack-local tests |
| 0x040 | `func_thunk`  | `e9 bb ff ff ff` (`jmp func_ret`) | thunk-flag tests |
| 0x050 | `func_noret`  | `eb fe` (`jmp $`) | no-return-flag tests |
| 0x100 | `data_point`  | `03 00 00 00 04 00 00 00` | 8-byte struct data item |
| 0x110 | `data_int`    | `f4 01 00 00` (500) | int32 data item |
| 0x120 | `data_str`    | `"GHIDRA\0"` | string data |

Filler between code entries is `int3` (0xCC); the data page (0x100–0x1FF) is
zero outside the listed items.
